correctness.rationale: All quantifiers, endpoint conventions, and entropy scaling were reconstructed. Positive-support KKT differentiation gives a PSD weighted-centering Jacobian. Its cross-norm is exactly a maximum sign cut. Block Jensen, strict convexity in group mass, and a strictly monotonic balanced-size relaxation prove the formula. Full-support positive probabilities are realizable, giving sharp finite-difference witnesses; convex-dual gradient Lipschitz regularity permits line integration. The 11040 deterministic supplementary checks from verify.py are supportive, not a universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural robust prediction operator now has a complete exact cross-norm law in every finite dimension and throughout a nontrivial entropy interpolation. The exponent-driven shift from softmax dimension independence to sparsemax linear growth, with strict odd-dimension losses and explicit worst-case probability blocks, supports exact perturbation budgeting and identifies structural equality geometry; neither routine renaming nor isolated numeric computation.
